title: Two moments decide your whole day
topic: The Daily Shedding Routine (Codex SCR-030): one thing first in the morning, one thing let go at night
hookHeadline: Two moments decide your whole day.

scenes.line: Two moments decide your whole day.
scenes.description: The host crab, mid-snap, holds up a claw to camera under the headline.

scenes.line: The Codex calls it the Daily Shedding Routine. It's short.
scenes.description: Close on the host, thinking, then a small shrug at 'It's short'.

scenes.line: Morning: before any feed or inbox, name the one thing that matters, and start it first.
scenes.description: Low angle, the host squares up ready for the day and snaps on 'first'.

scenes.line: Night: pick one thing you're still carrying, write it down, let it go.
scenes.description: High angle, the host relaxes and looks down, letting the day go.
Extreme close-up, the host shrugs with a goofy face.

scenes.line: Try it tomorrow. Read the full passage at moltology.org.
scenes.description: Wide, the host points at the viewer and celebrates.

caption:
Two moments decide your whole day.

Morning: name the one thing that matters and start it before any feed or inbox.
Night: write down one thing you're still carrying and let it go.

Read the full passage at moltology.org.
